study type: Computational analysis of public microarray datasets
cohort: The study utilized gene expression data from two public microarray datasets (GSE75010 and GSE35574) consisting of samples from individuals with preeclampsia and control individuals.
finding: A diagnostic logistic regression model comprising seven genes (MKNK1, ARNT, FLT1, SERPINE1, ENO3, LDHA, BCL2) from the HIF-1 signaling pathway demonstrated high accuracy (AUCs of 0.923 and 0.845) in discriminating preeclampsia from controls.
